Step 3: aggravating and mitigating factors
Step 3 deals with aggravating and mitigating factors. Aggravating factors are facts and
circumstances which may lead to the offence being regarded as more serious for sentencing
purposes. Mitigating factors, including factors personal to the offender, may lead to a less
severe sentence being imposed.
